title: Onboarding customer risk classification and review policy
workflow: Select institution/jurisdiction risk policy and customer/product context
Gather only legally justified risk factors and source evidence
Identify missing and contradictory data without silently substituting defaults
Compute explainable preliminary risk recommendation from approved versioned rules
Route high/uncertain assessments to qualified compliance and possibly enhanced due diligence
Record signed decision, policy edition and reevaluation triggers
rules: Do not invent threshold values or treat model output as binding regulator policy
Identity verification, screening, eligibility and customer risk assessment remain distinct decisions
Missing high-impact input generates INSUFFICIENT rather than an arbitrary low-risk result
Document protected-trait/fairness considerations and prevent unnecessary sensitive proxies
Only approved personnel may override risk recommendation, with rationale and expiry
Reassessment on material relationship, geographic, control or product change preserves prior history
planned_test_cases: Missing required high-risk factor blocks automatic low-risk assignment
Changed policy version produces separate reproducible decision
Customer from another institution cannot reuse approval
Reviewer cannot remove prior decision history
Explainability output shows source and rule version
acceptance_gate: Qualified AML/risk owner, effective-dated local policy, assessed fairness/privacy controls and signed test fixtures.
